name: Find relevant provisions
description: Ranks the instruments and provisions of the treaty corpus against the case, with TF-IDF, BM25, SBERT or any method the service offers. A threshold decides what counts as retrieved.

config.label: Methods offered
config.help: Comma-separated method ids, as listed by the service's methods operation. Leave one to hide the picker.

config.label: Default threshold
config.help: 0 to 1. Documents and provisions scoring at or above it are retrieved. BM25 scores are normalised per query, so the same number means different things for each method.

config.label: Research mode
config.help: Shows relevant/distractor badges and precision, recall and F1 against the scenario's ground truth. The service only returns ground truth to the admin role.
